changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Route PRS dbt-backed screen SQL to the Postgres mart alias and reserve the federated alias for Trino cross-database queries.
changeSet.sql: WITH mart_database AS ( UPDATE analytics_database db SET details_json = ( SELECT ( base.details || jsonb_build_object( 'logicalSourceAliases', ( SELECT jsonb_agg(alias ORDER BY alias) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT alias FROM ( SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(base.details -> 'logicalSourceAliases') = 'array' THEN base.details -> 'logicalSourceAliases' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END ) AS alias UNION ALL SELECT 'prs.flowerbiz.mart' ) source_aliases WHERE alias IS NOT NULL AND btrim(alias) <> '' AND lower(alias) <> lower('prs.flowerbiz.federated') ) deduped_aliases ) ) )::text FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(db.details_json, '')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb) AS details ) base ), database_role = 'BUSINESS_SECONDARY', updated_at = ${now} WHERE lower(db.name) = lower('DTS dbt模型库') RETURNING id ), repaired_screens AS ( UPDATE analytics_screen SET components_json = regexp_replace( components_json, '"databaseAlias"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"prs\.flowerbiz\.federated"', '"databaseAlias":"prs.flowerbiz.mart"', 'g' ), updated_at = ${now} WHERE id BETWEEN 290001 AND 290012 AND archived = false AND components_json LIKE '%prs.flowerbiz.federated%' RETURNING id ), repaired_versions AS ( UPDATE analytics_screen_version SET components_json = regexp_replace( components_json, '"databaseAlias"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"prs\.flowerbiz\.federated"', '"databaseAlias":"prs.flowerbiz.mart"', 'g' ) WHERE screen_id BETWEEN 290001 AND 290012 AND components_json LIKE '%prs.flowerbiz.federated%' RETURNING id ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mart_database) AS mart_database_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repaired_screens) AS repaired_screen_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repaired_versions) AS repaired_version_count;
